tests.trajectory_resume: Final resume verifies every completed prefix process without relaunching GPU work.

normal185_replication_statistics.policy: All completed valid observations retained; pooled unit is a fresh-process median.

repeat_policy.policy: Keep every completed valid timing. Repeat suspicious variation; do not replace a slower valid result with a favorable rerun.

normal_repeat.reason: Prior candidate warmed forward medians differ by 13.0%, with gradient medians differing by 10.0%. Repeat a full balanced ABBA block and report both blocks plus pooled summaries.

trajectory_repeat.trigger: Within-arm design-stage or complete-harness max/min > 1.10 after the initial two valid processes per arm
trajectory_repeat.response: Run one additional fresh process for each arm in BA order, retaining all original observations and reporting pooled and original series separately.

repeat_policy.interruptions: Exclude incomplete guard-stopped or user-stopped processes; preserve their raw evidence and restart fresh.

trajectory_variation.policy: One matched BA pair if either within-arm ratio exceeds 1.10; retain all valid initial and repeated timings.

excluded_interruptions.policy: Interrupted timings excluded; retain verified a1 and start b1 in a fresh snapshot/process after unchanged quiet-window guard

excluded_interruptions.reason: User requested end turn and continue evaluation later

a1.limitation: Fresh diagnostic calls only; historical calls lack direct traces and call arrays.

b1.limitation: Fresh diagnostic calls only; historical calls lack direct traces and call arrays.

historical_counter_investigation.inference: Both native committed and completed buffer deltas agree. Adjacent calls do not compensate. Donation counts are unchanged. No per-call arrays or direct Metal trace exist for these two historical calls; causal attribution is unavailable.
historical_counter_investigation.abi: Frozen header and disassembly agree: dispatches accumulates encoder.operations synchronously at commit; GPU time/completed counters update in callbacks.

validation_repairs: Initial repository test used macOS GUI backend and aborted; headless CPU rerun and final guarded suite passed.
Admission fixtures corrected for JAX compile cache, explicit shared convert fanout, and single-level versus nested helpers.

Final layout review found v2 changed native BF16 reduction rounding for a transposed source. All v2 timings discarded. Final v4 requires row-contiguous source provenance and contiguous windows, with the failing case retained as a negative-admission regression and positive row BF16 reductions.

V3 row proof was safe but missed rematerialized gradient weights behind alias-only optimization barriers. Final v4 follows that proven alias with positive row and transposed-source negative tests; all final timings rerun.
Direct-only v1 pilot missed function-wrapped AF2 slices; final v4 admits helpers structurally with proven row layout. Pilot excluded from final timing results.
Initial tracer reader loaded independent identical MLX counter image and reported zeros; fixed same-image export, identity and exact direct/native accounting. Initial diagnostic146 excluded.
185 BAAB CLI initially rejected before GPU launch; driver allows B-first order with both saved reference and previous inputs.

One partial trajectory was stopped by the activity guard for corespotlightd compute; another partial retry was stopped at the user request. Both retained and excluded. Resume validates the completed prefix and launches fresh snapshots/processes.
limitations: Two fresh processes per arm in initial blocks. Warmed repeats correlate. Additional 185-residue block and any matched trajectory repeat are reported separately and pooled with every valid initial observation.
Initial 185-residue gradient median is 2.8% higher, with gradient process ranges overlapping at 185 and 169 residues. Replication is disclosed separately; completed slow timings are retained.
Shared desktop/GPU and thermals are uncontrolled; guards cannot prove GPU exclusivity. The trajectory series spans a user-requested pause.
Historical 196-dispatch deficits lack per-call traces/arrays and remain causally unattributed. Fresh exact accounting does not explain them retrospectively.
Diagnostic timing excluded. Logical bytes are not physical DRAM traffic or exclusive time shares; host API intervals are not CPU usage.
Physical footprint/RSS do not isolate GPU allocations; system swap/pressure include other apps.
Fixed-work trajectory uses shared downstream fixtures and yields zero accepted designs; it cannot establish accepted-design throughput.
next_priority2_opportunity: Measure fusing FP32 dynamic slicing with BF16 conversion to remove the observed extra ~0.725 GB of logical FP32 slice traffic per call; preserve clamp, rounding, uses and lifetime. No speedup is forecast.
